lead: Paid advertising either prints money or burns it. The difference is almost never the budget — it's the strategy behind it.
intro: Businesses running Google Ads without proper conversion tracking. Meta campaigns targeting audiences that haven't been tested. Landing pages that don't match the ad copy. Budgets spread across platforms that don't actually perform.
At Bhiive, we manage paid marketing campaigns for B2B businesses, service brands and e-commerce companies that want predictable lead generation and measurable returns — not vanity metrics.
highlights: Optimised for cost per qualified lead and ROAS
Conversion tracking verified before we scale
Google Ads leads often within the first week

sections.heading: The problem with most paid marketing agencies
paragraphs: Most agencies optimise for metrics that look impressive in reports but don't grow your business. High click-through rates don't matter if the leads don't convert. Low CPCs don't matter if the traffic is unqualified.
We optimise for what actually matters: cost per qualified lead, conversion rate, customer acquisition cost and return on ad spend (ROAS).

sections.heading: Paid marketing in 2026: what's changed
paragraphs: Google's AI-powered Smart Bidding and Meta's machine-learning systems now reward advertisers who provide strong conversion data, high-quality creative and optimised landing pages.
Today, creative quality, accurate tracking, landing page optimisation and first-party data matter more than manual targeting hacks.

faqs.q: What's the minimum budget for Google or Meta Ads?
faqs.a: We typically recommend ₹30,000–₹50,000 per month for Google Ads and ₹20,000 per month for Meta Ads to gather enough optimisation data.

faqs.q: How long before paid campaigns generate results?
faqs.a: Google Ads can generate leads within the first week, while Meta campaigns often need 2–4 weeks of testing and optimisation.

faqs.q: Do you create ad creatives and copy?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle ad copywriting, campaign messaging and creative strategy for paid campaigns.
Absolutely. We audit and optimise existing Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn campaigns for better performance.
